t: An AI vision camera with nine built-in functions and online programming through Mind+.
steps: Find the HuskyLens PRO on the DFRobot site and ask the vendor about price.
Power the unit at 3.3 to 5 V.
Pick one of the nine functions on the screen.
Teach the camera an object with the learning button.
Connect the Gravity cable to a host controller.
Open Mind+ online and program the controller.
Test the full project and adjust the code.
